headline: World Cup ⚽🔥 makes NFL 🏈😵‍💫 Car Guy a SOCCER SIMP 🥅💘
text: Indiana 🚗💨 car salesman Jamie Druley, 51, was straight-up NFL 🏈🤪 obsessed until the Tartan Army 🍺🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 rolled into Boston and turned his world UPSIDE DOWN ⬆️⬇️! He started watching the World Cup ⚽🌍 on home soil and now he’s SCREAMING 📣😱 at the TV like it’s the Super Bowl every night! Wife texting from the bedroom “QUIET DOWN 📵💤” while he bets his BOSS 💼🤑 on the final and they’re both YELLING 😂🔥 during England vs Argentina! Druley’s even eyeing season tickets for Fort Wayne FC 🏟️🎟️ after their new 9,200-seat stadium dropped! Fox says 30 MILLION 📺🚀 watched USA vs Belgium – biggest English soccer broadcast in US HISTORY 📜🏆! Average 5.1M viewers across 72 matches, a 92% JUMP 🐸📈 from 2022! Pennsylvania mom Courtney Silbaugh, 33, went from “not a sports spectator at all” 🙅‍♀️ to “OBSESSED” 😍⚽ after watching every game except six! She tried American football 🏈 but it flopped, baseball was a blur 👀❌ but soccer clicked! Banker grandma Heather Earhart, 54, in Indiana caught the England bug 🇬🇧🎶 with Hey Jude and Oasis Wonderwall blasting while she cleans the kitchen 🧹🎤! She’s now YouTubing “how to curve the ball” tutorials ⚽📚 and plans to hit the Indy soccer bar 🍺🥅! Connecticut coach Nate Roberts, 40, is drowning in 10-20 emails a week 📧😵 plus double on socials from parents wanting kids in pickup “beer leagues” 🍻⚽ for 18+! Everyone’s vibing on the global camaraderie 🌍🤝 and positivity at the World Cup! Druley says “maybe what the world needs right now” but he’s got ONE LIMIT 🚫 – he’ll NEVER call it football, it’s SOCCER 4EVER 🇺🇸😂!
